details.description: The OpportunityAdobe is looking for a Machine Learning Engineer who will apply AI and machine learning techniques to big-data problems to help Adobe better understand, lead and optimize the experience of its customers. Partnering with the business units, the candidate will be building various products that address challenging business problems through our customers’ full lifecycle, from customer analytics to marketing media optimization.By using statistical and econometric methods, predictive models, experimental design methods, and optimization techniques, the candidate will be working on the research and development of exciting projects like attribution, media mix modeling, budget optimization, personalization, causal analysis, time series analysis.Ideal candidates will have a strong academic background as well as technical skills including applied statistics, machine learning, data mining, and software development. Familiarity with working with large-scale datasets and big data techniques would be a plus.What You’ll DoDevelop predictive models on large-scale datasets to address various business problems with advanced statistical modeling, machine learning, and analytics techniques. Develop and implement scalable and efficient modeling algorithms that can work with large-scale data in production systemsCollaborate with product management and engineering groups to develop new products and features. What You Need to SucceedPhD or MS in Computer Science, Statistics, Electrical Engineering, Applied Math, Operations Research, Econometrics or equivalent experience required with an expected graduation date of December 2026 – June 20270-2+ years of experience in specific relevant skillsDeep understanding of statistical modeling, machine learning, deep learning, or data mining concepts, and a track record of solving problems with these methods. Proficient in one or more programming languages such as Python, Scala, Java and CFamiliar with one or more machine learning or statistical modeling tools such as R, Matlab and scikit learnKnowledge and experience of working with relational databases and SQLStrong analytical and quantitative problem-solving ability. Excellent communication, relationship skills and a strong team player. About AdobeAdobe empowers everyone to create through innovative platforms and tools that unleash creativity, productivity and personalized customer experiences. Adobe’s industry-leading offerings including Adobe Acrobat Studio, Adobe Express, Adobe Firefly, Creative Cloud, Adobe Experience Platform, Adobe Experience Manager, and GenStudio enable people and businesses to turn ideas into impact, powered by AI and driven by human ingenuity.Our 30,000+ employees worldwide are creating the future and raising the bar as we drive the next decade of growth. We’re on a mission to hire the very best and believe in creating a company culture where all employees are empowered to make an impact. At Adobe, we believe that great ideas can come from anywhere in the organization. The next big idea could be yours.Let’s Adobe togetherAt Adobe, we believe in creating a company culture where all employees are empowered to make an impact. details.description: Junior Machine Learning Engineer – Medical ImagingAbout HolobeamHolobeam Technologies is a cutting-edge medical technology company developing advanced medical imaging technologies designed to improve clinical care and help save lives.We are looking for a Junior Machine Learning Engineer – Medical Imaging to join our team and work at the intersection of medical imaging, computer vision, machine learning, and data quality.What You’ll DoReview and validate medical imaging studies, DICOM metadata, annotations, segmentation masks, and model-generated outputs.Develop reproducible quality-control and data-validation workflows.Train, benchmark, and evaluate computer vision and segmentation models.Identify data, preprocessing, annotation, and model-output issues.Perform error analysis and root-cause analysis of model and data failures.Prepare validated datasets and outputs for downstream ML development.Document methods, experiments, decisions, and results.Work with technical and clinical stakeholders and escalate cases requiring additional review.What We’re Looking ForStrong Python skills and hands-on experience with PyTorch.Experience training and evaluating computer vision or segmentation models.Practical experience with medical imaging data.Working knowledge of DICOM.Understanding of model evaluation, experimental design, dataset partitioning, and error analysis.Familiarity with imaging anatomy sufficient to recognize technically inadequate studies or anatomically implausible outputs without performing diagnostic interpretation.Strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and technical communication.Experience with X-ray, CT, medical-image segmentation, annotation workflows, or medical-imaging data pipelines is a plus.Why HolobeamYou’ll work on challenging technology with meaningful healthcare applications while gaining hands-on experience across the machine learning lifecycle. As Holobeam grows, strong performers will have the opportunity to take on increasing technical ownership and responsibility.LocationPreferred Beth Page New York / Hybrid or remote is possible for exceptional candidates, with daily / periodic in-person collaboration based on team and project needs.Compensation & BenefitsCompetitive salary, equity stock options, 401K, bonuses, full benefits including an excellent health care plan.Long Island, NY (ranked the safest county in the U.S.)High autonomy, rapid iteration, and real technical influenceIf you are excited about applying machine learning and computer vision to medical imaging and want to work on technology with the potential to improve and save lives, we would like to hear from you.Holobeam Technologies is an equal opportunity employer.Contact: Jobs@holobeamtech.com

details.description: DescriptionAre you searching for a place to build upon the foundation of your academic work?Are you searching for engaging work with an employer that prioritizes impact, innovation, and personal development?Are you looking for meaningful work in a driven intellectual environment?If so, we're looking for someone like you to join our team at APL!We are seeking recent college graduates to help us tackle the complex research, engineering, and analytical problems that present critical challenges to our nation. Our group is currently making critical contributions in developing the first truly autonomous unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) and advancing research in computer vision and reasoning systems. We apply artificial intelligence (AI), reasoning, machine learning (ML) operations, data science, systems engineering, and more to solve urgent tactical problems. We support sponsors in defense, homeland security, and health care, conducting research to address critical challenges.As a member of our team you will...Work with dedicated team members charged with developing and delivering solutions that support national prioritiesWork within a team environment and apply your skills to projects and tasks in areas such as Machine Perception, Intelligent Systems, Reasoning for Autonomy, Software Engineering, Machine Learning Operations, AI Assurance, and Data ScienceQualificationsYou will meet the minimum qualifications for the job if you...Possess a Bachelor's degree or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Engineering, or related technical fieldAre able to obtain an Interim Secret clearance by your start date and can ultimately obtain a Top Secret level security clearance. If selected, a government security clearance investigation will need to be conducted and the requirements met for access to classified information. Eligibility requirements include U.S. citizenship.About UsWhy Work at APL?The Johns Hopkins University Applied Physics Laboratory (APL) brings world-class expertise to our nation’s most critical defense, security, space and science challenges.
